case: Custom enum SQL-file replay with both standard_conforming_strings settings
values: enum label containing literal backslash+n and an apostrophe
contract: SQL file output renders backslash-bearing PostgreSQL values as E strings with doubled backslashes, independent of standard_conforming_strings.
The same generated INSERT replays with (standard_conforming_strings=on, backslash_quote=safe_encoding) and (standard_conforming_strings=off, backslash_quote=off).
Both replays preserve exact enum text and pg_typeof; each transaction rolls back after verification.
The core literal decoder test verifies escape-string parsing, and existing PostgreSQL enum SQL-file replay remains unchanged for ordinary, empty, Unicode, NULL and injection-shaped labels.
